newsitem.title: ITALY: Fininvest/IBM deal opens way for internet on TV.
newsitem.headline: Fininvest/IBM deal opens way for internet on TV.

text.p: Italian media group Fininvest SpA's computer services outsourcing deal with IBM announced on Friday will help Fininvest to develop new offers like electronic shopping, home banking, on-line insurance and video on demand, managing director Ubaldo Livolsi said.
Fedele Confalonieri, chairman of Mediaset, Fininvest's television group, added that the future for broadcasters also included "television via personal computer or internet on TV screens."
Confalonieri noted that Mediaset aimed to continue with its core business of broad-based television but wanted to be ready "for the future when media technologies converge."
The executives were speaking at a news conference to announce the outsourcing deal with IBM to create the new company ICT Servizi, held 80 percent by IBM and 20 percent by Fininvest.

Among the nearer term goals in the partnership with IBM, Confalonieri underlined the potential of developing archive digitalisation separately from the whole range of multimedia services and of "content distribution".
